grade: C+ provisional - playable Snake; deadline reached during broken verifier work
strengths: Independent final-source checks pass keyboard start/movement, reversal protection, keyboard pause/resume, wall/self collision, tail-vacate handling and restart after death.
Eating food grows the snake and increases score; the tested interval changes from 140 to 133 ms after the first food. The delivered HTML has no external dependencies.
Developer returned a complete app in about 6.5 minutes. Final source matches the saved developer-stage artifact; tester did not modify application code.
defects: Clicking Resume resets the game: the original startBtn click listener always calls startGame, alongside the later onclick resume handler. A paused fixture with six segments and three points becomes a fresh game with three segments and zero points.

Food placement stops after 500 random attempts and accepts the last candidate even if occupied. A nearly-full-board fixture demonstrates the invalid fallback; this fixture does not measure random-play failure frequency.
Space is handled without preventDefault because the prevention list contains a literal space rather than the Space code. Page scrolling or native button activation remains browser-unverified.
The shared 60 minute deadline elapsed during tester execution. UI was initially rejected because of concurrent separate foreground subagent calls and never subsequently ran.
verification: Exact final-source event and physics fixtures in reports/roles_ornith_02_snake.qa.cjs/.qa.json. The event harness separately verifies that both addEventListener and onclick callbacks execute.
Final SHA-256: 1a20a12a5805b08e5e0e0cd65f71346d9ea96fcf508018db267348b95099ea2a matches the developer-stage snapshot.

One infrastructure-only recovery terminated an identified Node test process after 7 minutes at 100% CPU. No application code or repair hint was supplied. Cleanup after the shared deadline found no remaining case 12 Node verifier processes.
verificationConcerns: Tester spent most of its time rewriting a homemade VM/DOM harness. It reported movement/scoring failures that are not reproduced by independent controlled fixtures, then entered an unbounded autoGrow loop.
After the one manual process termination, another verifier call remained pending until the project deadline. Developer's successful core tests did not cover the broken Resume button.
The renderer is a partial Canvas shim. Audio, native scrolling, browser appearance and compatibility were not checked.
scopeCompliance: OS write boundary active. An attempted /tmp/snaketest.js write was blocked; subsequent verification files stayed inside the project. No successful out-of-tree write observed.
workflowNotes: Developer completed; tester ran but did not complete; UI request was rejected by the one-call-per-turn guard. Foreground delegation itself worked. One logged infrastructure notice accompanied termination of a hung test subprocess. No app advice or implementation was provided. Protocol/timeout revision 2 applies only to subsequent cases.
title: Snake
lastAssistantText: No external references — the file is fully inline. Now let me delegate independent testing to a tester and a read-only UI review to a UI reviewer.
limitations: No independent browser/visual testing; earlier browser-origin denial honored. VM/DOM/canvas shims do not establish browser compatibility or visual polish.
Single trial per task and configuration; sampling variance prevents strong causal attribution.
